Buy, sell and close Sona PAPER trades straight from Friday, typed or spoken:

- "buy gold 0.1 lot", "sell 0.05 lot SL 4150 TP 4080", "buy 5 oz gold"
- "close my trade", "close my buy", "close all trades"

Friday always shows a confirmation first (side, size in lots and oz, XAU/USD, Sona's last price and how old it is, TP/SL) with Confirm / Cancel; saying "confirm" or "cancel" works too. No size = Friday asks; nothing is sent from an unclear command. Sona then places or closes the trade itself with its own PIN session and its usual checks (live price, market hours, daily limits, margin, TP/SL sides), and Friday shows the fill price or Sona's exact reason for refusing. Needs Sona 1.2.8 or newer. Paper trading only - no broker, no real money.

Also: the in-app updater is back (Settings > Check for updates, plus an automatic check every 6 hours), so future Friday releases install from inside the app.

Built on v80 (all v73-v80 changes kept). Signed with the same key as v80 and v1.0.160, so it installs over either without uninstalling. Checked by CI tests, not yet on a phone.
